Halloween Has Just Begun

musiclucke

The moon is shining in the night,
The ghosts are dancing, what a sight!
The witches fly across the sky,
And spooky bats go flying by.

The moon is shining in the sky,
The little bats are flying high.
The pumpkins glow for the Halloween show,
The spooky shadows start to grow.

Trick or treat, let’s shout hooray,
It’s Halloween — our favourite day!
Trick or treat, let’s have some fun,
Halloween has just begun!

Witches fly and pumpkins glow,
Spooky shadows dance below!
Ghosts are floating through the night,
Bats are flapping out of sight.

The pumpkins glow with eerie light,
The spookiest bats fly through the night.
Witches fly into the scene,
Because tonight is Halloween!
